# make data frame for region

```{r}
# define region

hokkaido <- c("JP-01")

tohoku <- c(paste0("JP-0", as.character(2:7)))

kanto <- c(paste0("JP-0", as.character(8:9)), 
           paste0("JP-", as.character(10:14)))

chubu <- c(paste0("JP-", as.character(15:24)))

kansai <- c(paste0("JP-", as.character(25:30)))

chugoku <- c(paste0("JP-", as.character(31:35)))

shikoku <- c(paste0("JP-", as.character(36:39)))

kyushu_okinawa <- c(paste0("JP-", as.character(40:47)))

```

```{r}
levels_reg <- c("Hokkaido",
                "Tohoku",
                "Kanto",
                "Chubu",
                "Kansai",
                "Chugoku",
                "Shikoku",
                "Kyushu\nOkinawa")
```

```{r}
levels_prf <- df_nuc_prf %>%
  arrange(iso_3166_2) %>%
  distinct(PRF) %>%
  pull(PRF)
```

```{r}
df_nuc_prf  <- df_nuc_prf  %>%
  mutate(REG = case_when(iso_3166_2 %in% hokkaido ~ "Hokkaido",
                         iso_3166_2 %in% tohoku ~ "Tohoku",
                         iso_3166_2 %in% kanto ~ "Kanto",
                         iso_3166_2 %in% chubu ~ "Chubu",
                         iso_3166_2 %in% kansai ~ "Kansai",
                         iso_3166_2 %in% chugoku ~ "Chugoku",
                         iso_3166_2 %in% shikoku ~ "Shikoku",
                         iso_3166_2 %in% kyushu_okinawa ~ "Kyushu\nOkinawa")) %>%
  mutate(REG = factor(REG, levels = levels_reg)) %>%
  mutate(PRF = factor(PRF, levels = levels_prf))
```

```{r}
# make map

map_jp <-  maps::map("japan", 
                       plot = FALSE,
                       fill = TRUE) %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  rename(PRF = "ID") %>%
  mutate(PRF = str_to_title(PRF))
```

```{r}
get_exp <- function(x){

  if (x > 0.001){
    
    return("")
  }
  
  else {
  
    p <- formatC(x, digits = 1, format = "e", flag = "#")
    
    ex <- p %>% str_extract("(?<=e).+") %>%
      str_remove_all("(?<=\\-)0+") %>%
      str_replace("-", "−")
    
    return(ex)
  }
}

get_expv <- Vectorize(get_exp)
```

```{r}
get_num <- function(x){

    if (x > 0.001){
    
      p <- formatC(x, digits = 2, format = "fg", flag = "#")
      
      return(p)
  }
  
  else {
  
    p <- formatC(x, digits = 1, format = "e", flag = "#")
    
    num <- p %>% str_extract(".+(?=e)")
    
    num <- str_c(num, "×10")
      
    return(num)
  }
}

get_numv <- Vectorize(get_num)
```

```{r}
label_nuc_prf_count <- rkt_nuc_prf_count %>%
  mutate(tau = formatC(tau, digits = 2, format = "fg", flag = "#")) %>%
  mutate(tau = str_replace(tau, "-", "−")) %>%
  
  mutate(p_exp = get_expv(p_value)) %>%
  mutate(p_num = get_numv(p_value)) %>%

  mutate(slope = round(slope)) %>%
  mutate(slope = scales::comma(slope)) %>%
  mutate(slope = str_replace(slope, "-", "−")) %>%
  
  mutate(label_slope = paste0("beta == '", slope, "'" )) %>%
  mutate(label_tau = paste0("tau == '", tau, "'")) %>%
  mutate(label_p = paste0("italic(p) == '", p_num, "'^'", p_exp, "'")) %>%
  
  mutate(xpos = 2018) %>%
  mutate(ylim = 150*10^3) %>%
  mutate(ytau = ylim * 0.25,
         yp = ylim * 0.1)

label_nuc_prf_count
```

```{r}
df_nuc_scales <- df_nuc_prf_count %>%
  group_by(PRF) %>%
  slice_max(SUM, n = 1) %>%
  mutate(ymax = case_when(SUM <500 ~ 500,
                         SUM >= 500 & SUM < 1000 ~ 1000,
                         SUM >= 1000 & SUM < 1250 ~ 1250,
                         SUM >= 1250 & SUM < 1500 ~ 1500,
                         SUM >= 1500 & SUM < 2000 ~ 2000,
                         SUM >= 2000 & SUM < 2500 ~ 2500,
                         SUM >= 2500 & SUM < 3000 ~ 3000,
                         SUM >= 3000 & SUM < 4000 ~ 4000,
                         SUM >= 4000 & SUM < 5000 ~ 5000,
                         SUM >= 5000 & SUM < 6000 ~ 6000,
                         SUM >= 6000 & SUM < 7500 ~ 7500,
                         SUM >= 7500 & SUM < 8000 ~ 8000,
                         SUM >= 8000 & SUM < 10000 ~ 10000,
                         SUM >= 10000 & SUM < 12500 ~ 12500,
                         SUM >= 12500 & SUM < 15000 ~ 15000,
                         .default = NA
                         )) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
# calculate national average

df_nuc_prf_pct_mean <- df_nuc_prf %>%
    filter(NUC != "ADF") %>%
  distinct(YEAR, SHEET, DRUG_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(YEAR) %>%
  summarise(SUM = sum(TOTAL)) %>%
  mutate(SUM = case_when(YEAR %in% c("2015", "2019", "2023") ~ SUM/366,
                         .default = SUM/365)) %>%
  left_join(df_pop_prf %>% filter(PRF_jp == "total") %>% select(YEAR, ALL_total),
            by = join_by(YEAR)) %>%
  mutate(PCT_mean = SUM/(ALL_total * 1000) * 100)

df_nuc_prf_pct_mean
```

```{r}
df_nuc_prf_pct <- df_nuc_prf %>%
    filter(NUC != "ADF") %>%
  group_by(YEAR, iso_3166_2) %>%
    summarise(SUM = sum(VALUE)) %>%
  mutate(SUM = case_when(YEAR %in% c("2015", "2019", "2023") ~ SUM/366,
                         .default = SUM/365)) %>%
  left_join(map_jp, join_by(iso_3166_2)) %>%
  mutate(ID = str_c(PRF_jp, "_", YEAR)) %>%
  left_join(df_pop_prf %>%
              mutate(ID = str_c(PRF_jp, "_", YEAR)) %>%
              select(ID, ALL_total),
            by = join_by(ID)) %>%
  mutate(PCT = SUM/(ALL_total*1000) * 100) %>%
  mutate(YEAR = as.numeric(YEAR)) 

df_nuc_prf_pct 
```

```{r}
label_nuc_prf_pct <- rkt_nuc_prf_pct %>%
  mutate(tau = formatC(tau, digits = 2, format = "fg", flag = "#")) %>%
  mutate(tau = str_replace(tau, "-", "−")) %>%
  
  mutate(p_exp = get_expv(p_value)) %>%
  mutate(p_num = get_numv(p_value)) %>%

  mutate(slope = formatC(tau, digits = 2, format = "g", flag = "#")) %>%
  mutate(slope = str_replace(slope, "-", "−")) %>%
  
  mutate(label_slope = paste0("beta == '", slope, "'" )) %>%
  mutate(label_tau = paste0("tau == '", tau, "'")) %>%
  mutate(label_p = paste0("italic(p) == '", p_num, "'^'", p_exp, "'")) %>%
  
  mutate(xpos = 2015) %>%
  mutate(ylim = 0.3) %>%
  mutate(ytau = case_when(PRF %in% c("Hokkaido", "Tottori") ~ ylim * 0.3,
                          .default = ylim * 0.9)) %>%
  
  mutate(yp = case_when(PRF %in% c("Hokkaido", "Tottori") ~ ylim * 0.1,
                         .default =  ylim * 0.7))

label_nuc_prf_pct
```

```{r}
cor_2024 <- cor(df_nuc_prf_2024$POP, df_nuc_prf_2024$SUM, method = "pearson")

cor_2024 
```

```{r}
df_nuc_prf_2024_cor <- df_nuc_prf_2024 %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(POP = POP/1000) %>%
  select(SUM, POP) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    fit = purrr::map(data, ~ cor.test(.x$POP, .x$SUM,
                                      method = "pearson")),
    tidied = purrr::map(fit, tidy),
    glanced = purrr::map(fit, glance)
  )
```

```{r}
df_nuc_prf_2024_cor %>% unnest(tidied)
```

# linear regression

```{r}
df_nuc_prf_2024_reg <-   df_nuc_prf_2024 %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(POP = POP/1000) %>%
  select(SUM, POP) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    fit = purrr::map(data, ~ lm(SUM ~ POP, data = .x)),
    tidied = purrr::map(fit, tidy),
    glanced = purrr::map(fit, glance),
    augmented = purrr::map(fit, augment)
  )
```

```{r}
# tidy
df_nuc_prf_2024_reg_tidy <- df_nuc_prf_2024_reg %>% unnest(tidied)

df_nuc_prf_2024_reg_tidy
```

```{r}
df_nuc_prf_2024_reg_tidy %>% select(term, estimate) %>% 
  mutate(term = str_remove_all(term, "\\(|\\)")) %>%
              pivot_wider(names_from = term, values_from = estimate) 
```

```{r}
df_nuc_prf_2024_reg %>% unnest(glanced)
```

```{r}
df_reg_label <- df_nuc_prf_2024_reg %>% unnest(glanced) %>%
  mutate(term = "POP") %>%
  left_join(df_nuc_prf_2024_reg_tidy %>% 
              select(term, estimate) %>%
              mutate(term = str_remove_all(term, "\\(|\\)")) %>%
              pivot_wider(names_from = term, values_from = estimate) %>%
              mutate(term = "POP"),
            by = join_by(term)) %>%
  mutate(p_label = case_when(p.value <= 0.001 ~ "*p* < 0.001",
                             .default = as.character(round(p.value, 3)))) %>%
  mutate(adj_r_label = round(adj.r.squared, 2)) %>%
  mutate(adj_r_label = as.character(adj_r_label)) %>%
  mutate(adj_r_label = case_when(str_length(adj_r_label) == 3 ~ str_c(adj_r_label, "0"),
                               .default = adj_r_label)) %>%
  mutate(intercept_label = round(Intercept)) %>%
  mutate(slope_label = round(POP)) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(
                        "*y* = ", slope_label, "*x*", " + ", intercept_label, "<br>",
                        p_label, "<br>",
                        "*R*<sup>2</sup><sub>adj</sub> = ",adj_r_label))
  

df_reg_label
```

```{r}
df_nuc_prf_2024_name <- df_nuc_prf_2024 %>%
  mutate(POP = POP/1000) %>%
  filter(PRF  %in% c("Tokyo",
                                        "Osaka",
                                        "Hokkaido",
                                        "Fukuoka",
                                        "Hyogo",
                                        "Kanagawa",
                                        "Aichi",
                                        "Saitama",
                                        "Chiba",
                                        "Shizuoka",
                                        "Hiroshima")) %>%
  mutate(hjust = case_when(PRF == "Shizuoka" ~ 0,
                           PRF %in% c("Hiroshima", "Chiba",
                                      "Hyogo") ~ 1,
                           .default = 0.5)) %>%
  mutate(vjust = case_when(PRF %in% c("Hokkaido",
                                  "Saitama") ~ 1,
                       PRF %in% c("Shizuoka",
                                  "Hiroshima",
                                  "Hyogo",
                                  "Chiba") ~ 0.5,
                       .default = 0)) %>%
  mutate(x = case_when(hjust == 1 ~ POP - 15/40,
                       hjust == 0 ~ POP + 15/40,
                       .default = POP)) %>%
  mutate(y = case_when(vjust == 1 ~ SUM - 15000/20,
                       vjust == 0 ~ SUM + 15000/20,
                       .default = SUM)) 
  
```
